question: Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic research is situated in:
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kalpakkam**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indira Gandhi **Centre for Atomic research is situated in Kalpakkam**
 
• Kalpakkam power station is located on the coromandel coast 70 km far from Chennai, Tamil Nadu State of India. 
 
• Kalpakkam **power station** is known as Madras Atomic Nuclear Power plants.
 
• It was commissioned on 24th January 1984 with a capacity of 470 MW.
 
• Kalpakkam nuclear power station is affiliated with the Indira Gandhi Centre for atomic research (IGCAR), and the Barc( Bhabha Atomic Research Centre).
 
• It is the only power station in India with a **Fast Breeder Test Reactor (FBTR)** and Pressurised Heavy Water Reactor (PHWR).
